description: Exact API of a three.js class, constant or member, read from the three version installed in the project (not from memory): constructor, properties, methods, deprecations and the right import path ('three' or 'three/addons/...'). Use it before writing or changing three.js code you are not sure about. Query: `Mesh`, `WebGLRenderer.setPixelRatio`, `OrbitControls`. Unknown names get did-you-mean suggestions. Read-only.

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

query.description: Class, Class.member or constant, e.g. WebGLRenderer.setSize

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.

name: three_api
title: three.js API lookup
